reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getRangedAmount/getWorstCaseAmount helpers that every consumer already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; two one-line edits to the shared definitions plus updated comments and tests.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines how ranged and approximate amounts are expected.

scope.why: Only the two helper bodies, their comments, a matching comment in forecast-schedules, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: The simplified Math.min / subtract-tolerance forms state the new rule directly in its single home.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No call site is changed; all go through the shared helpers.
